claims.claimText: Nanjing University's trial generative-AI guidance from the Undergraduate School applies to undergraduate students.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: 第三条 基本原则。学校在本科教育教学中统筹考虑人才培养多元性、课程资源多样性等因素，据此探索在不同教育教学场景下，对生成式人工智能工具使用建章立制，并确保相关制度的可操作性与可衡量性。第四条 适用对象。本指导意见适用于所有本科生。

claims.claimText: For listed allowed-use contexts, Nanjing University undergraduate guidance permits generative-AI tool use only after written signed or electronically signed consent from the course instructor or thesis/project supervisor.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: 第二章 允许使用范围及要求。在征得任课老师、指导教师书面签字（含电子签名）同意的前提下，可在以下范围内使用生成式人工智能工具：第五条 辅助收集整理资料。原则上，在选题调研、文献检索、资料整理、参考文献格式整理等不同阶段时，可借助生成式人工智能工具辅助完成。
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: The allowed-use section is conditioned on written signed or electronically signed consent from the course instructor or supervisor.
evidence.snippetLocation: 第二章 允许使用范围及要求

claims.claimText: For undergraduate thesis or project use of AI, Nanjing University guidance requires advance written application and a dedicated AI-use statement page when submitting the work.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: 如毕业论文（设计）需使用人工智能技术，学生应提前向指导老师与所在学院提交书面申请，说明使用工具名称、版本、参数设置、使用目的、使用环节及范围、使用方式及预期效果等，获批准后方可使用。
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: Article 13 requires advance written application and approval before AI use in undergraduate thesis or project work.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: 提交任务成果时，应专设人工智能工具使用声明页，说明使用的工具名称、版本、使用时间、使用过程、具体用途及对成果贡献影响，并亲笔签名，以使评审者能够准确评估学生自主创作与工具辅助界限。
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: Article 15 requires a dedicated AI-use declaration page when submitting work.

claims.claimText: Nanjing University undergraduate guidance allows generative AI to assist with topic research, literature search, material organization, and reference formatting, but requires students to assess generated information and forbids directly copying generated content to replace independent research.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: 原则上，在选题调研、文献检索、资料整理、参考文献格式整理等不同阶段时，可借助生成式人工智能工具搜集信息，但须对生成式人工智能生成信息的真实性、准确性、可靠性进行辨识，不得直接抄袭搬运生成式人工智能工具生成的内容来替代自主研究。
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: Article 5 allows AI-assisted information gathering and organization, but requires verification and bars directly copying generated content to replace independent research.

claims.claimText: Nanjing University undergraduate guidance says violations of the generative-AI rules may lead to measures such as warnings, lowered grades, cancellation of undergraduate thesis defense eligibility, or degree-related consequences when academic misconduct is involved.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: 对于违反本规定使用生成式人工智能工具的行为，将视情节轻重给予相应的处理。包括：警告并责令改正；降低论文、课程或实验成绩；本科毕业论文（设计）视情节给予取消毕业论文（设计）答辩资格、取消合格成绩等处理；构成学术不端的，按照学校相关管理规定给予相应处分。
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: Article 17 says violations may trigger warnings, grade impacts, thesis-defense consequences, or academic-misconduct discipline depending on severity.

attribution.citationTitle: 关于本科生规范使用生成式人工智能工具的指导意见（试行）
attribution.sourceRights: Tracker metadata is open licensed. Official source documents, page text, PDFs, and other source materials retain their original rights and terms.

claims.claimText: Nanjing University undergraduate guidance says students should use nationally registered AI services and forbids uploading data, images, or other sensitive information from confidential papers or reports to AI platforms unless specially approved by relevant departments.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: 在选择人工智能技术时，应使用经国家备案登记的服务工具；禁止滥用人工智能技术危害数据安全、侵犯知识产权、泄露隐私机密、传播有害歧视性内容或违反伦理道德规范；论文、报告等涉及保密内容的，除获得相关部门特别批准外，禁止使用任何生成式人工智能工具进行辅助处理，同时，严禁将文档中的任何数据、图片或其他敏感信息上传至人工智能平台。
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: Article 12 addresses registered services, data security, privacy/confidentiality, and sensitive-information upload restrictions.
